outputs.name: scores

inputs.name: logits_b

outputs.name: predictions
outputs.constraints: Two-font ensemble mapping including CPU joint_classes tensor. Each branch separately softmaxes14784 logits and marginalizes components before ensemble component selection. Independent component maxima can produce a joint class neither branch selected directly.

inputs.name: truth_components
inputs.constraints: Aligned integer calibration labels (N,3) in canonical168/11/7 component ranges.

inputs.name: known_class_mask
inputs.constraints: Boolean vector of length14784 identifying known joint classes, aligned with the fixed ontology. Use identical membership for calibration and query routing. Membership and unseen-class claims require caller provenance.

inputs.name: sample_weight
inputs.constraints: Aligned finite nonnegative calibration weights with positive total; caller justifies target mixture.

inputs.name: thresholds
inputs.constraints: Nonempty finite candidate threshold vector in [0,1]; calibration searches only this grid.

outputs.name: calibration
outputs.constraints: Fitted finite threshold and grid scores from independent calibration rows. Weighted component macro recall uses explicit sample weights and2:1:1 component weights. Ties choose the smallest supplied threshold. Grid optimality is not unbiased application performance.
